warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SDV6 Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your Range Rover Sport SDV6 has the 3.0-litre diesel V6 — across both the L320 and L494 generations — timing chain tensioner wear and injector seal leaks are a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple technical service bulletins and specialist sources. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every SDV6 rebuild.
The SDV6 shares this pattern across both generations — the underlying engine is the same unit throughout the L320 and L494 production runs.
warning.source: Source: same as Range Rover TDV6/SDV6 pattern (per G-BRF), widely documented with multiple TSBs and specialist sources, per VRF-range-rover-sport.md. Applies to all SDV6 variants across L320 and L494
